summary: Iteration 5 validated the shift from server-side PDF to client-side native browser print, A4/US Letter page-size selector, Settings>Brand logo-upload flow, print-emulation isolation, DOCX export, and share-page UX. Backend: test_print_api.py = 9/9 pass; backend_test.py = 29 pass + 3 known/expected 404 failures for the removed PDF routes (TestDocuments::test_pdf_a4, test_pdf_letter, last assertion of test_share) — NOT reported as bugs per request. Frontend end-to-end flows all pass on the preview URL.
action_items: None blocking. Optional nit: pytest.ini forces `-n 2 --dist loadscope`; when REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is NOT exported in the shell, test_print_api.py defaults BASE to http://localhost:8001 and xdist workers appear to lose cookie auth across requests. Running `pytest -n 0` with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported makes all 9 pass. Consider either (a) having test_print_api.py read REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env as the backend_test.py suite does, or (b) adding BASE validation that fails fast if it points at localhost.
critical_code_review_comments: test_print_api.py reads only backend/.env for env; REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL lives in frontend/.env, so BASE silently defaults to http://localhost:8001 unless exported externally. Low priority but easy to improve robustness.

success_rate.backend: 100% of in-scope tests (test_print_api 9/9; backend_test 29/32 — 3 failures are the intentionally removed PDF routes)

seed_data_creation: During testing: 3 throw-away invoices (INV-0002, plus 2 earlier) + 1 statement_of_work (SOW-0001) + 1 receipt (REC-0001) from pytest runs. All were deleted. Profile logo cleared back to ''. Documents collection empty, counters collection reset — the user's next real invoice will be INV-0001. default_currency verified = 'INR'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Key verified testids: print-button, print-hint, print-hint-size, print-confirm, page-size-select, page-size-a4, page-size-letter, document-canvas, canvas-add-line-item, remove-line-item, save-document-button, export-menu (NOT 'export-menu-trigger'), export-docx, share-button, share-link-input, share-page-size-select, logo-upload-input, logo-preview, logo-remove, doc-logo. New-document flow: /documents/new -> click Invoice tile -> click 'Create & edit' button -> lands on /documents/{id}. Login lands on '/' not '/dashboard'. Export menu now contains ONLY 'Word · DOCX' (no PDF items). Canvas widths measured at full-scale: A4=793.69px, Letter=816px. Print-emulation (page.emulate_media(media='print')) correctly hides sidebar/header/toolbar/add+remove buttons via display:none; only document-canvas remains visible. Share page has no `<a href>` containing 'pdf'. Settings>Brand has NO text 'Logo URL' input — only Upload + preview + Remove. Uploaded PNG becomes a data: URI in logo-preview src and renders as [data-testid=doc-logo] in the invoice masthead.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. The 3 failing tests inside backend_test.py (test_pdf_a4, test_pdf_letter, last line of test_share) are intentional — the server-side PDF endpoints were removed and now return 404; this is the designed behavior for the new client-side-print architecture and must NOT be fixed.
